title: Netflix Announces Release Date for 'Lust Stories 3' Anthology
summary: Netflix announced the release date of the sequel anthology film 'Lust Stories 3'. The film will consist of four new short stories. The stories are directed by Vikramaditya Motwane, Kiran Rao, Shakun Batra and Vishal Bhardwaj. Actors Konkona Sen Sharma and Radhika Apte are reported to return to the series. The announcement was reported by multiple Indian media outlets.
summary_points: Netflix announced the release date of 'Lust Stories 3'.
The anthology will contain four new stories.
The four directors are Vikramaditya Motwane, Kiran Rao, Shakun Batra and Vishal Bhardwaj.
Konkona Sen Sharma and Radhika Apte are returning to the film.
